description: Automatically calibrate response effort and token usage to match task complexity. Use this skill at the START of every response to classify the incoming task and select the appropriate effort tier before generating any output. Trigger whenever you're about to answer a question or complete a task — this skill saves tokens on simple queries and reserves depth for complex ones. Especially useful for: quick factual questions, long technical tasks, coding problems, multi-step reasoning, creative writing, research, explanations, and analysis. If you're not sure how much effort a task needs, consult this skill.
